Many ticketing systems are designed primarily with technical teams in mind.
BoldDesk is simple, clean, and user-friendly, making it easy for employees of all technical skill levels to use.
And that's important because support isn't just an IT function.
Teams all across Northpointe are answering questions, handling requests, working with documents, solving problems, and supporting other employees and customers every day.
BoldDesk gives those teams a way to manage that work without having to completely change how they communicate with the people they support.
